heading: Platform base
proposed: - A `Placeholder` element of the UI model can also be marked as a custom implementation. The generator turns it into a spacer that keeps its grid position and copies the flag, so the scaffold `register<Interface>CustomImplementation` is generated for it and the page renders the component in a `ComponentProxy` at that position, with the generated empty spacer as fallback. Use it for one region of a page. A placeholder cannot replace a whole view; for that, mark a container (see the custom view notes in the model blueprints).

heading: Implementation Pattern
replaces: To render a custom layout, the view must be a visual element that the UI model declares as a custom implementation widget.
proposed: To render a custom layout, the view must be a visual element that the UI model declares as a custom implementation widget. Mark one container (a group or flex element) that holds the whole view: the registered component replaces that container and everything inside it, because the generated children are only the fallback that the component proxy renders when no component is registered, so the view is not built field by field. The page container itself is not a visual element and has no flag, so a view cannot be replaced by a page-level hook; mark the top-level container of the view instead.

heading: When No Manual Step Is Needed
replaces: It is a startup log, not a build failure: run the schema upgrade for that database (see the migration rules below).
proposed: It is a startup log, not a build failure: run the schema upgrade for that database (see the migration rules below). If the check itself cannot run, the log shows the same error with a `NoClassDefFoundError` for `hu.blackbelt.epsilon.runtime.execution.contexts.EolExecutionContext`, and a schema upgrade does not help. Known issue: the RDBMS model bundle imports the Epsilon runtime packages as optional, and the `judo-meta-rdbms` feature does not install the `epsilon-runtime` feature, so the compatibility check fails when the database already holds a model version. Workaround: add the `epsilon-runtime` feature to the application's Karaf boot features, restart, and check that the `Could not find compatible schema model` line is gone. An empty database does not reach this check: the prehook creates the model store and the schema on start.
